For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.aurorasolar.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

You have access to a fully integrated, multi-step solar workflow in the Aurora application. With Aurora’s APIs, you can also integrate key Aurora workflows across your technology ecosystem to automate and scale existing processes. For example, Sync API makes it simple to synchronize your solar workflows in Aurora with those in the rest of your IT ecosystem in real time.

The following tutorials show how to apply Aurora’s APIs and event webhooks to automate common use cases that we've seen across our customers.
